description: Stage F forward-folding chi2 fit for Crab SED cells.

site.sidereal_time_formula: IAU-style GMST polynomial from MJD plus east longitude; no astropy/IERS download.

exposure.method: per-file midpoint integration of Stage C rough live time into source theta bins

reference_count_preflight.reference_source: Hu 2023 Crab catalog value corrected to 2.114e-12 TeV^-1 cm^-2 s^-1 at 3 TeV
reference_count_preflight.note: Stage F still writes a diagnostic fit when this fails; Stage G physical SED should wait until Stage A absolute response normalization is understood.

quality.reason: fits are finite; physical normalization preflight controls Stage G promotion
